g.title: ENC6
g.text: no external pull-ups - Pico B internal pull-ups on A/B/SW (firmware)

g.title: OLED0
g.text: I2C0 0x3C, 1 MHz (400 kHz fallback) - needs the module's pull-ups

g.title: OLED1
g.text: I2C0 0x3D (addr resistor moved), 1 MHz (400 kHz fallback) - needs the module's pull-ups

g.title: OLED2
g.text: I2C1 0x3C, 1 MHz (400 kHz fallback) - needs the module's pull-ups

g.title: MIDI
g.text: 5 V moves from Pico B VBUS (pin 40) to VSYS (pin 39) for the single-supply build.
